items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: And I said, “Great article” by I think Burt Korall had written it.

ctx.x: That’s what I was getting at when I got a little off track there about listening to a recording. We’d listen — we didn’t have YouTube. And this is not saying oh let’s go back to the good old days, it’s just a matter of we had no choice but to listen to that record over and over and over and over and realizing that every time we listened to it we heard something new. It’s like reading Huckleberry Finn when you’re 12 years old and then reading Huckleberry Finn when you’re 50 years old. A whole different ballgame.…

Drummer magazine?” He said, “Yeah, I do.” I said, “Did you see that article about Tiny Kahn?” And I said, “Great article” by I think Burt Korall had written it. And the kid goes, “Yeah I saw it.” I said, “Did you read it?” He said, “No. I didn’t read it.” I said, “Why didn’t you read it?” Are you ready for this? His answer was, “Because I didn’t know who he is.”
There’s a weird loop to that thing.
